text:
deploybot: Scheduled rollout: routing-service v1.8.0 -> prod (canary 22:30 UTC, ramp 23:00).
incident-bot: New incident INC-9333: eu-west KVS replication lag causing stale reads and occasional write conflicts.
lina: ops asked to pause any deploys that change KVS write path or replication config.
marco: v1.8.0 contains a replication backoff change. stopping promotion now.
dee: please pin the release slot to v1.7.9 and mark v1.8.0 quarantined. hold release notes publish.
deploybot: Command executed: `pause rollout routing-service v1.8.0` 1: rollout paused, slot pinned to v1.7.9, auto-promote disabled.
marco: rollback snippet: `deploybot promote routing-service v1.7.9 --force --reason "INC-9333 replication-lag"` 1:ops ready to run on call.
incident-bot: INC-9333 updated: investigation started (labels: kvs, replication, eu-west, medium).
ops(eng): quick triage: replication backlog in eu-west due to spike in gc and a flakey cross-region link. testing a throttle for large writes and a replication window reduce. ETA 18m.
lina: if mitigation passes in staging, propose a constrained micro-canary 2% with strict SLO gates and a 10m observation window.
dee: agree. change window tentatively moved from 22:30 -> 02:30 UTC pending triage. I'll update the release calendar and notify stakeholders once we confirm.
marco: added kill-switch and verification to runbook: `deploybot abort rollout routing-service v1.8.0` then `kvs-check --region eu-west --consistency verify`.
release_lead: internal comms on hold; support and sales will get an update only after triage outcome.
marco: note: pinned slot will block scheduled rollouts until unpinned. to unpin run `deploybot unpin routing-service`.
lina: if rollback required, perform promote to v1.7.9 and run `replay-writes --region eu-west --since 1h` after to reduce drift.
dee: also flagging that release notes must show quarantined status and not ship public changelog until cleared.
incident-bot: INC-9333 updated: mitigation testing (throttle + reduced repl window) in staging, preliminary green.
marco: if staging stays green, I can run micro-canary in 60m: 2% -> 15% -> 50% with circuit-breaker on replication lag > 500ms or error rate > 2x baseline.
lina: sounds good. next update in 15m or on status change. keep convo here unless there's customer impact. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
dee: :thumbsup:
release_lead: :lock:
